Backbone geometry around B:V348:

- CA(345)–CA(348) ≈ 9.2 Å, CA(346)–CA(349) ≈ 9.2 Å, CA(348)–CA(351) ≈ 9.9 Å — far too extended for helix (α-helix i,i+3 ≈ 5–5.5 Å).
- Torsions at V348: φ ≈ −85°, ψ ≈ +129° (extended/PPII region, not helical).
- However, no β-bridge partner exists: the nearest non-neighbouring CA atoms (350, 353, 354) are 6.3–7.5 Å away, and no backbone N–H···O=C pairs (N348/O348 to any partner) fall within H-bonding distance (nearest candidates > 4.8 Å). The only backbone H-bond in this region is an isolated O350···N354 (2.95 Å) turn contact.

Thus V348 lies in an extended but non-hydrogen-bonded, non-paired segment — neither helix nor sheet.

FINAL: coil
